<!--
# Release Notes Instructions

Please follow this format when drafting the release notes.
- The sync process validates the release body and will fail if the required format is not followed.


IMPORTANT:
- The release introduction is optional.
- Keep the category headings exactly as shown, including the 📝 emoji.
- Use only the categories that are relevant to this release.
- Remove any category that has no entries. Do not leave unused categories in the release body.
- Each entry must be placed under the appropriate category.
- Do not change the heading levels:
    ### for categories
    #### for entries
- Each entry must follow this format:
    #### #<PR_NUMBER> | <TITLE>
    
    <DESCRIPTION>
    
    > Contributors: @<USERNAME> [@<USERNAME> ...]

- PR_NUMBER must be the actual GitHub Pull Request number.
- TITLE must be the title of the entry.
- DESCRIPTION should briefly describe the change.
- Every entry must include a Contributors line.
- Contributors must be GitHub usernames beginning with @.
- Multiple contributors should be separated by spaces.
- Do not use commas between contributor usernames.
- Do not add text or entries outside the defined structure.
- Replace the `Entry` placeholder under each category with the actual release entry, or remove the entire category if it is not used.

Example Entry:

#### #1042 | Revamp USER Dashboard

Full redesign of the user interface according to the latest design specifications for improved usability.

> Contributors: @personA @personB

-->
